parts.label: HN13-N101 / PUBLISHED MAJOR OUTER PROFILE
parts.note: All exterior primitive sizes come from the 22-May-2019 individual part drawing: flange diameter 26 x 2.6, boss diameter 10 with projection 4.9 - 2.6 = 2.3. The eight M2.5 major-diameter cylinders and four diameter 2 plain holes follow the explicit through patterns. The central retaining clearance, rear lip/recess details, DC13 serration, small edge treatments and retaining hardware are omitted. This is a partial outer-profile reference, not the complete horn or a thread/fit model.

assumptions: No estimated numerical geometry is emitted. This partial solid contains only the published major flange/boss profile and the explicit through-hole reference patterns.
Local Z0 is the outer flange face. The published section puts the diameter 10 boss on the outward positive-Z side.
The central retaining cavity, rear lip/recess, serration teeth, small edge treatments, washer and retaining screw are omitted. The resulting solid is not a complete manufactured part.
Tapped holes use nominal thread-major-diameter cylinders. Helical surfaces and tap-drill/minor diameters are not reconstructed.
The 2019-03-18 assembly depth limits and 22-May-2019 through callouts remain distinct source statements; no physical revision is inferred.
Angular phase is an explicit user orientation, not a verified servo neutral or tooth index.

observations.note: The individual drawing is dated 22-May-2019. N101 has eight M2.5 x 0.45 TAP THRU holes on PCD22 and four diameter 2 HOLE THRU on PCD16. The DC13 inset gives 32 teeth, a 90-degree angle, diameter 8 and diameter 7.4; those facts do not authorize an invented smooth mating bore or tooth fillet.
The official Horn index maps HN13-N101 PDF to download 1737. Its wrapper publishes https://www.dropbox.com/s/ry89g6jkfavwr6l/HN13_N101.pdf?dl=1, which was downloaded and rendered for this audit.

The older 2019-03-18 assembled HINGE drawing remains the source for case-relative outer-flange placement. Its maximum-depth callouts are not silently merged with the individual-part specifications or interpreted as proven physical revisions.
Named SKU 903-0276-000 explicitly supports XM540 normal-output use. Compatibility does not make omitted cavities or neutral phase known.
The normal thrust washer and separately installed opposite-side idler are distinct interfaces. A documented outer flange plane does not define every internal contact surface.

parts.note: Literal diameter callouts define the major circular reference: outer diameter 19.95, hub diameter 9, plate 2.5, total 4.5; hub projection is derived as 4.5 - 2.5 = 2. Four nominal M3 major-diameter reference cuts follow PCD14 and the sectioned through-plate topology. The 25T serration pocket and central clearance cavity are omitted entirely; no guessed smooth diameter 5.9 pocket is used. The source raster polygonizes its pitch circles as well as the outside views. No physical facet count, flat angle or polygon vertex is inferred. General-note chamfers and helical thread surfaces are omitted.

assumptions: This partial local solid uses the literal diameter and axial dimension callouts. It is a major-profile reference rather than the complete manufactured horn.

Rasterized source contours are polygonal, including the diameter 14 pitch circle and nominally round holes. That rendering does not specify physical facets; no polygon count, flats or vertex coordinates are inferred.
Local outer flange face is Z0. The hub extends toward negative Z by the published total height minus plate thickness; no extra overlap or guessed hub length is used.
The 25T pocket and central clearance cavity are omitted. A nominal 5.9 size label is not substituted by a smooth bore or an invented tooth profile.
M3 cut cylinders are thread-major-diameter references. Pitch, helical surfaces, thread class, usable engagement and general-note chamfers are omitted.
All installed STS poses remain unknown. A local source-backed profile does not establish case-relative XY, seat height or angular phase.
